name: FlyHead
summary: A testbed where a GPU-simulated whole-brain fruit-fly connectome (FlyWire, 138,639 neurons, 15.09M connections) drives a real wheel-legged robot. I built the platform around the upstream LIF model, including sensor encoders, the neuron decoder, safety layer, LiDAR SLAM navigation and web console.

name: Sky Atlas
summary: A live, bilingual stargazing site that computes visibility for any place and time. I built the FastAPI back end, three.js front end, API docs, monitoring, and tests; the site renders about 109,000 real stars across 16 orders of magnitude of scale.

name: ANSYS_simulation_IOP
summary: Finite-element models of the eyelid and eyeball for a home-use transpalpebral tonometer. During my Shenzhen InnoX Academy internship, I wrote the ANSYS APDL models and scripts that supported the probe-control and calibration work behind three patent applications.

name: code-with-pi
summary: A terminal broker where an AI coding agent and its user watch or take over the same live shell. I wrote it in C11 over Windows ConPTY and POSIX PTY with authenticated local IPC, and added CI tests on Windows and Linux.

name: ForgeSpec-Studio
summary: An AI-assisted CAD tool that turns a loose engineering brief into a reviewable assembly specification. I built it to generate deterministic CadQuery source from a standard-parts library and export STEP and STL with a browser preview.

name: ANSYS_skill
summary: A validation layer for automated ANSYS Mechanical runs. I built it to record the stage each run reached and the result evidence behind it; a cantilever benchmark matches Euler-Bernoulli theory within 0.223%.

name: Harmony_TaskFlow
summary: A HarmonyOS systems-integration experiment: a task app with calendar sign-in, a cloud back end and a native proxy core.

name: CoughKD
summary: A research pipeline for cough-audio screening. It prepares subject-disjoint data and distils large audio teachers into smaller student models.

name: pixel_probetop
summary: A lightweight multi-server monitor used to watch the research group's GPU servers, with a web UI and an Android viewer.

name: stm32-cli-toolkit
summary: A set of shell wrappers around OpenOCD for building and flashing STM32 projects from a terminal or headless machine.

name: MES204 LCD projects
summary: STM32F446 character-LCD projects from the Microprocessor Systems module, including a T-Rex game, custom characters and graphics experiments.

name: terminal-gauss-Mamma-viz
summary: A terminal renderer written in C that draws mathematical surfaces in perspective using ANSI colour.
